purpose: Three new favorite-style dark-breakbeat remixes with much quieter vocals and optional darker piano/violin counterlines.

alignmentCaveat: Grid starts at the supplied file boundary; vocal onset around 0.73 seconds is retained as a late entrance. research.use: Verse/chorus lyric order, cross-checked with the user's supplied excerpt. Lyrics are not reproduced in this fixture.
